title: Extract 2

title: Building D Projection Room Safe
info: Safe located behind the Building D Projection Room Key door in the second level of the cinema in Building D.

title: Cable Car Station Extract
info:
Use the Cable Car Switch to call a cable car. Pay 7,500 Koen to activate the Extraction Point.

Stand in either cable car to start extraction.

title: Cable Car Switch
info: Pulling this opens the Cable Car Station Extract, but requires 7,500 Koen (On your peron). Once switch is pulled, extract will complete in 180 seconds. Be in the extract area to get out (Either cable car). Pulling this will alert the map.

title: Armored Vehicle
info: Deliver 2 dog tags and get 60s to extrac uing the Armored Vehicle Extraction Point.

title: Dam Sluice Gate
info: Open the sluice from the Dam Sluice Gate Switch located on the second floor of the dam to start the 90s countdown for the first-floor Extraction Point.

title: Dam Sluice Gate Switch
info: Pulling this opens the Dam Sluice Gate Extract on the first floor. Once switch is pulled, extract will complete in 90 seconds. Be in the extract area to get out. Pulling this will alert the map.

title: Lifeboat
info: Use the lifeboat key to turn on the engine. 50s to activation.

title: Extract 7
info: Only available sometimes. More info required.

title: Parking Lot
info: Active 25min after the raid starts. Only available sometimes.

title: Eastern Bridge

title: Village End
info: Always available and open (if spawned on opposite side of map).

title: Rock Lookout
info: Great recon spot on top of this rock. You can see right into the main building in Camp Services. I've killed many players here using this rock.

title: Hotel Lookout
info:
Great spot to lay down and target players inside the fences of the Northridge Hotel. If you line yourself up right, you can actually see into the hallway of Building D.

Another great perk about this spot is that you can hear/see enemies running along the roadway before they have a chance of knowing you're there.

title: Shoreline Rat Spot
info: HUGE rat spot. You can position yourself on top of this rock to watch and snipe players trying to look the safe on bridge or players along the shoreline.
